audit_method: Full 1 MiB ROM scan for 24-bit $7E:F5xx long references and 16-bit absolute references; verified 0 conflicting vanilla reads/writes in $7E:F500..$7E:F53F.

native_alttp_wram_used.$7E:0308: Player Carrying Object Flag (1->0 triggers Turn-Block Coin reward)
native_alttp_wram_used.$7E:037B: Player Untouchable Flag (Jump apex, Stomp/Yoshi escape i-frames, Starman)
